content:
zoe: Quick thread  proposal: instead of a wide JSON header for policy, we standardize a tiny TLV-ish kv header `x-rw-hint` for SDKs and an internal compressed payload `x-rw-baggage-cbor` that only the mesh adds. SDKs keep stable surface, platform can attach rich context. feedback?

rik: interesting. TLV style in a single header avoids ad-hoc CSV parsing. Example: `x-rw-hint: tenant=acme;env=prod;cc=42`. How do quotas/console read it?

maya: quota/dashboard: prefer explicit fields. If `cc` absent, quota falls back to best-effort parse of hint. We'll add a parser that extracts tenant & cost_center from `x-rw-hint` first.

ben: SDKs (py/ts/go) will expose `Client.set_route_hint(dict)` that serializes into the TLV header. We'll ship parsing for both TLV and old blob for 2 releases. For private/dedicated, opt-in `RW_ALLOW_CBOR` env enables sending `x-rw-baggage-cbor` (base64 encoded). Default off.

qa-bot: earlier canary saw `json parse error` when proxies got large header. Using CBOR+base64 reduces text size and parse ambiguity, but still watch header limits.

zoe: decision leaning: SDKs must only send `x-rw-hint`. Platform attaches `x-rw-baggage-cbor`. For Dedicated only, env opt-in. Action: @ben add APIs + tests, @maya update quota fallback, @rik file RFC and deprecate old wide header in 10w.

ben: will add unit tests, examples, and changelog blurb. sample header docs: 
```n# public (SDKs)
x-rw-hint: tenant=acme;env=prod;cc=314
# internal (mesh only)
x-rw-baggage-cbor: h2Fsd...  # base64(cbor)
```

rik: timeline: RFC Tue, 2-week canary, deprecation notice at 10w. We'll monitor console attribution metrics after canary.

maya: I'll add a console migration job to backfill missing cc from historical data if needed.

qa-bot: canary scheduled Fri 06:00 UTC. Logs to follow.
